tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the Bionic Forms apps this key can open, with each app's id, name and record count.

tools.name: describe_app
tools.description: Show an app's collections (the kinds of record it holds) with every field's id, label, type and choices, plus its views.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: List records in one collection, with their fields. Optional query narrows by title.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search an app's records by text across titles and text fields.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Read one record in full by its id.

tools.name: add_record
tools.description: Add a new record to a collection. fields maps field id or label to its value; dates are YYYY-MM-DD, choices use one of the field's options, links use the linked record's id.
